# Lab 20.12: Enforce Binary Authorization on GKE

## What We Are Going to Do
Require a signed attestation before an image can run on GKE, then sign an image and deploy it.

## Steps

1. **Enable APIs and create a cluster with enforcement.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable binaryauthorization.googleapis.com containeranalysis.googleapis.com container.googleapis.com
gcloud container clusters create-auto binauthz-lab --region=us-central1 \
  --binauthz-evaluation-mode=PROJECT_SINGLETON_POLICY_ENFORCE
gcloud container clusters get-credentials binauthz-lab --region=us-central1</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Create a signing key in Cloud KMS.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud kms keyrings create binauthz-ring --location=global
gcloud kms keys create qa-key --keyring=binauthz-ring --location=global \
  --purpose=asymmetric-signing --default-algorithm=ec-sign-p256-sha256</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Create a note and an attestor.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">curl -s -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-access-token)" \
  -H "x-goog-user-project: $PROJECT_ID" \
  -d '{"attestation":{"hint":{"human_readable_name":"QA passed"}}}' \
  "https://containeranalysis.googleapis.com/v1/projects/$PROJECT_ID/notes/?noteId=qa-note"

gcloud container binauthz attestors create qa-attestor \
  --attestation-authority-note=qa-note --attestation-authority-note-project=$PROJECT_ID

gcloud beta container binauthz attestors public-keys add --attestor=qa-attestor \
  --keyversion-project=$PROJECT_ID --keyversion-location=global \
  --keyversion-keyring=binauthz-ring --keyversion-key=qa-key --keyversion=1</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Require the attestor in the policy.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">cat &gt; policy.yaml &lt;&lt;EOF
globalPolicyEvaluationMode: ENABLE
defaultAdmissionRule:
  evaluationMode: REQUIRE_ATTESTATION
  enforcementMode: ENFORCED_BLOCK_AND_AUDIT_LOG
  requireAttestationsBy:
  - projects/$PROJECT_ID/attestors/qa-attestor
EOF
gcloud container binauthz policy import policy.yaml</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Try an unsigned image.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">export REPO=us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/$PROJECT_ID/lab-repo
docker pull nginx:stable-alpine &amp;&amp; docker tag nginx:stable-alpine $REPO/nginx:signed &amp;&amp; docker push $REPO/nginx:signed
export DIGEST=$(gcloud artifacts docker images describe $REPO/nginx:signed --format="value(image_summary.digest)")
kubectl run unsigned --image=$REPO/nginx@$DIGEST</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The pod is denied: no attestation from `qa-attestor`.

6. **Sign the image and deploy again.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud beta container binauthz attestations sign-and-create \
  --artifact-url=$REPO/nginx@$DIGEST \
  --attestor=qa-attestor --attestor-project=$PROJECT_ID \
  --keyversion-project=$PROJECT_ID --keyversion-location=global \
  --keyversion-keyring=binauthz-ring --keyversion-key=qa-key --keyversion=1

kubectl run signed --image=$REPO/nginx@$DIGEST
kubectl get pods</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The pod runs. Always deploy by digest, never by tag.

7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud container clusters delete binauthz-lab --region=us-central1 --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Keep the attestor and policy for the Cloud Run lab.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Unsigned image | Blocked at deploy |
| Signed image | Allowed |
| Image reference | By digest |
| Emergency | Break-glass annotation, always logged |
